text:
Marta (AE): Kickoff for Verdant Retail POC. Need to lock use cases: discovery chat, personalized recommendations, and in-store assistant. Also pricing for 30-day pilot, and answers for security questionnaire.

Ben (SE): Suggested minimal endpoints: /v1/chat.generate, /v1/embeddings.encode, /v1/rerank. Will draft integration README.

Ajay (Solutions Eng): Perf notes: use KV cache + batching; hosted OK for ~10k req/day but Dedicated if they need strict p95 <200ms.

Riley (Product): Proposed success metrics: retrieval R@1 >= 0.7; rerank NDCG@5 +15% vs baseline; p95 chat <= 500ms; hallucination <5% on eval set.

Priya (Security): Need anonymized sample data, confirm no cardholder data, SSO requirement (SAML), and EU region for EU stores. I'll start vendor questionnaire.

Marta (AE): I'll ask Verdant to provide anonymized data and sign off on EU hosting. Also will prepare a one-page POC spec.

Ben (SE): Pricing rough: hosted ~ $0.60 per 1k chat tokens + $0.10 per 1k embeddings; Dedicated from ~$10k/mo. Will give ballpark for 10k/day by EOD.

Ajay (Solutions Eng): I'll seed 500 eval prompts and recommend model family (rw-chat-3 / quantized). Will prepare eval harness.

Priya (Security): Two blockers: region confirmation and data sample for redaction plan. Assigning questionnaire to myself.

Marta (AE): Timeline: week0 security + data, week1 integration, week2 evals, week3 perf tuning, week4 demo + decision.

DeployBot: New security questionnaire created -> link sent to Priya.

Marta (AE): Assignments recap: Ben -> integration + pricing, Ajay -> eval harness + model recs, Priya -> security Q + data signoff, Riley -> eval targets, Marta -> POC one-pager. Back here after estimates. :thumbsup:
